title: Vercel theme
description: A near-monochrome developer-platform light theme: #fafafa page, white windows and buttons, #171717 ink for headings and primary buttons, #4d4d4d grey text and #ebebeb hairlines, with a single bright blue for status and focus. Geist and Geist Mono, tight display tracking, small 6px corners next to pill buttons. A near-black dark sibling.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling in the same spirit (#0a0a0a page, #ededed ink)
--highlight is the one blue (status line, focus), --glow its light tint used only in placeholders
--section-y is the desktop padding (7.5rem); blocks use smaller fixed padding on phones
--page-width + --page-gutter give a 24px full-bleed edge up to 1440
